home.title: Player Zero — Games and apps
home.description: Player Zero makes games and apps. In development: KEYCERTO, a keyboard rhythm game you can also play with your own music, and Meloom, a companion app with scenery from different countries, weather you can see and a pet.
home.about: Player Zero is an independent maker of games and apps. We care about how software feels to play, to make your own, and to keep around from day to day.

about.title: About Player Zero
about.description: Player Zero is an independent maker of games and apps, built around the experience of playing, making and spending time with software.
about.lead: Player Zero is an independent maker of games and apps.
paragraphs: What interests us is the time you actually spend with software: the focus of getting something right while you play, the pleasure of making something your own, and the quieter time with an app that is simply good to have around.

So we pay attention to how things feel to use. Controls you can pick up in a minute. Room to bring in something of yours, whether that is a piece of music, a choice of colour or a corner to arrange. Small details that are still there to notice the next time you come back.
